title: Effects you can edit, routing and XY pads
thisBuild: Perform effects: hold one to use it, slide along it while you hold to set how much, and tap ✎ in its corner for settings: While held, Stays on or Slider, and where it acts (the mix, Bus 1 to 4, or one pad).
Stutter, tape stop, gate, ring mod, octave down, crush, dirty, echo and reverse all work on one pad or one bus as well as the whole mix.
Routing: hold a pad, then Route, to send it to a bus. The pad shows B1 to B4.
Doctor's table, Effects: Reverb (amount and space), Echo (amount and 1/16 to 1/4), Dirty, Crush, Chorus and Wobble. Save as a new sound bakes them in, tails and all.

Every pad has an XY setup (hold a pad, then XY setup): two-way, or four-way with zero in the middle. Pick what each direction moves: pitch, filter, resonance, volume, pan, attack, release, start point, any doctor effect, glide, a repeat roll, gate, ring, stutter or tape stop.
Presets: Sweep, Dub, Bend, Lo-fi and Scrub, plus Save as mine.
Draw a circle on a pad or a Padiano note: a clear sphere opens over it, bigger than the pad. Keep moving to play its XY; lift to close it. On a Padiano note it bends that note only.
XY on a Padiano header shows the pad's XY under it. The dock can hold an XY button that flips through presets for the pad you picked.
watch: Put the hats on Bus 1, aim Stutter at Bus 1, and play with the loop running.
Give a pad the Bend preset, then circle a Padiano note and swing it around.
Add reverb in the doctor and save it as a new sound.
limits: Reverb and echo are shared spaces: the sound you played last sets their size and time.
On a single Padiano note, the sphere moves that note's pitch and level; other targets move the whole pad.
The site plays these sounds without the new effects.
